parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Umuokom (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 156.2 | 0.60549 | 0.60549
2 | 421.4 | 0.33169 | 0.93718
3 | 2559.4 | 4.3105 | 5.2477
4 | 1032 | 30.476 | 35.724
5 | 75.659 | 10.418 | 36.766
6 | 1081.5 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Umuokom
Curve type: AKQH
Aquifer depth: 35.7 m – 46.1 m (extending into Layer 6)
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 50 to 60 m to penetrate through the conductive clayey horizon (Layer 5) and fully exploit the prolific sand aquifer of Layer 6. Ensure appropriate screen placement and continuous gravel packing to maintain borehole yield and prevent fine sand ingress.
